position_overview: Who are we? SupportYourApp is a global Intelligent Support-as-a-Service leader, partnering with tech companies and industry leaders like MasterCard, Calm and MacPaw in 30+ countries since 2010 to deliver secure customer and technical support. We operate globally, supporting clients in 60 languages across diverse industries. So what if you had a chance to be a part of the world's leading SaaS, software, or hardware solutions? Join our community as a QA Engineer today and thrive in a multicultural and multilingual environment while enjoying your home office. Unlock your potential by mastering new skills and achieving challenging goals in cooperation with our People First management approach. Excited? Let's see what it takes. What you will do: Develop comprehensive test plans based on functional and technical specifications to ensure complete coverage; Create, maintain, and execute detailed manual test cases using Zephyr integrated with JIRA; Actively participate in daily squad stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives in an Agile environment; Log, track, and manage defects in JIRA , verify fixes, and coordinate retesting activities to ensure quality resolution; Validate user stories and tickets to confirm compliance with defined acceptance criteria before release; Apply a Shift-Left testing approach by engaging early in the development lifecycle and collaborating closely with Product Owners and Development teams; Partner with Frontend engineers to transition manual test scenarios into automated test scripts using Cucumber, Gherkin, and Playwright; Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by enhancing automated test coverage and supporting reliable, stable deployments; Perform and support network, performance, smoke, and visual regression testing in production and customer-facing environments; What you need to succeed in this role: Excellent English communication skills is a must (C1 both spoken and written) ; 4-5 years of hands-on QA experience in SaaS or software product-based companies; Strong understanding of software testing principles , methodologies, and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC); Proven experience working in Agile environments , with familiarity in Shift-Left testing practices; Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and quality integration within continuous delivery environments; Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work autonomously
